text:
marta: FYI - the spectral25b int4 canary in qa hit repeated OOMs on coldstart. Saw it during a 03:12 run, host g4-12.
perf-bot: deploy-failure: host=g4-12 task=spectral25b-canary reason=OOM_kv_alloc stack=alloc_prefetch+0x1f4
anil: can you paste the smallest repro log? also what were the model config defaults (batching, max_new_tokens, prefetch)?
marta: log snippet below:
```
[03:12:07] prefetch_slots=6 prefetch_window=64 max_new_tokens=512 batch=32
[03:12:07] alloc_kv_request 12.3GB -> total_kv_reserved 34.1GB
[03:12:08] OOM when allocating 4.2GB for kv_prefetch
```
cheng: hypothesis: big prefetch window + high default max_new_tokens is causing huge transient KV reservations during coldstart. With batch=32 it's multiplying. Looks like the slot allocation doesn't compact until later.
sam: i repro locally by running small bench with --coldstart: with defaults peak_gpu=49GB, warmstart run peaks ~33GB. lowering max_new_tokens to 128 drops peak to ~34GB and eliminates OOMs, but latency tail shifts slightly.
luis: suggested mitigations (ordered): 1) lower default max_new_tokens to 128 for canary, 2) reduce prefetch_window to 8 and prefetch_slots to 2, 3) enable soft slot compactor on startup (slot_compactor=fast), 4) set kv_trim_on_evict=true to free stale prefixes.
marta: i'm drafting a config patch with those values. quick config diff:
```
model_configs:
  spectral25b:
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 128
      prefetch_window: 8
      prefetch_slots: 2
      slot_compactor: fast
      kv_trim_on_evict: true
      batch: 16
```
perf-bot: quick bench run requested by marta: `make bench MODEL=spectral25b RUNS=200 --max-new=128 --batch=16 --prefetch=8`
perf-bot: bench result: peak_gpu_mem=34.2GB avg_latency=72ms tail_p95=210ms OOMs=0 (previous baseline: peak=49.0GB, OOMs=3)
anil: good. next: need to validate quality/regression impact of quant + lower max_new_tokens. Run eval suite on the 3 critical prompt sets (summaries, code, multi-turn). Put results under /evals/spectral25b/2026-03-xx.
cheng: also recommend a warmstart experiment: disable prefetch on first N requests to avoid giant spike. Implementation: prefetch_mode: gradual with initial_prefetch=0 ramp_to=2 over 2 requests.
sam: i ran quick QA with sample prompts - no obvious regression in ROUGE or basic coherence but need full eval.
marta: plan: (1) submit PR with config changes + prefetch-gradual flag; (2) canary 10% for 6 hours in eu-west1; (3) run eval suite and baseline perf; (4) if no regression and no OOMs, roll to 50% then GA. tagging @oncall-infra for potential kernel param tweak if compactor affects perf.
luis: add a regression alert to the model's eval dashboard to watch generation quality deltas >2% on our core sets.
anil: one more note - if we still see fragmentation, enable aggressive slot compaction during off-peak (cron) and add metric kv_reserved_peak to tracing.
marta: thanks all. I'll post the PR and bench logs here once CI finishes. :thumbsup:
sam: +1
perf-bot: PR CI passed, bench artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/spectral25b/canary-1767004321
marta: follow-up: canary deployment started (10% eu-west1). Monitoring mem and evals. I'll update thread with any hits.
